text: Coffee with Hana and Kerry. Hana's got a second interview at the council on Thursday and she's properly nervous. Kerry's just been made redundant, found out Monday. Text Hana good luck the night before.

Long call with Manon tonight. Her dad died last week, very suddenly, heart attack while gardening. Funeral is next Tuesday in Lyon and she's flying out Saturday with her brother Antoine. Her mum wants everyone there the day before to help with the food. Manon sounded completely flat, like she hasn't taken it in. Need to send flowers to the house before she goes, and maybe ring her on the Wednesday after.

Caught up with Lena after work, finally. She and Kai broke up a fortnight ago, after nearly four years. She's mostly fine she says, but sleeping badly and not eating much. Kai's moved back to his mum's in Croydon for now. Her sister keeps sending her flat listings which isn't helping. I'm taking her for dinner Friday, somewhere with no memories attached.
Deepa called. She got the job at the hospital!! Starts in a fortnight, two weeks after her notice ends. Her husband's taking her away this weekend to celebrate. Send her a card.
Quick catch up w Sara. Applied for the Edinburgh role, hears back next week. Her sister Marisol is visiting Thursday to Sunday. Ask Sara on Monday if she's heard anything.
Anil's mum passed away on Sunday. Aisha told me at pickup. Funeral's probably the end of next week, she'll let me know. Don't forget to ring Anil tomorrow, not just text.

Kalani and Rin came round. Rin's interview at the museum went ok she thinks, they said they'd decide by Friday. Kalani's training for a half marathon in March. Rin loves the Ghibli stuff, bday's in December.

Jamal rang. Got let go from the agency on Tuesday, whole team gone. He's surprisingly upbeat, already applying to three places. His partner Suzanne is nervous about money though. Should check in with him next week.
Kwame's leaving do was Friday, ended up at the curry house till late. He starts at the bank the Monday after. Ask him how the first week went.

Lunch with Abebe (Abe) and Moira. Moira's dog Biscuit had his operation yesterday, all fine, wearing the cone and sulking. Abe's off to Addis for his cousin's wedding next month, two weeks. The day before he flies they're having a big family meal at his aunt's. He's still job hunting too, had a phone screen with an insurance firm on Monday and they want him in for a second round after he's back.
Lindiwe's dissertation interview for the PhD is on Wednesday afternoon. She's terrified. Her girlfriend Adaeze is driving her up that morning. Remind me to message her afterwards to see how it went.
Miriam and Amy split up. Amy's moving out this weekend, Miriam keeps the flat and the cat Pepper. Miriam says she's relieved more than sad. Popping round with wine on Sunday evening.
Tariq texted. Funeral for his uncle is Thursday at 11, wake afterwards at the rugby club. I'm going with Chris. Get a card to sign on the way.
Archie had his panel interview today at the uni. Said it was brutal, 5 people on the panel. They're ringing candidates tomorrow. Text him tomorrow evening whatever happens.
Talked to Wiremu on the phone. His nana died in the spring and they finally have the unveiling in Rotorua next month, whole family going. He's taking two weeks off. Ask about it when he's back.

Jack, Femi and Zainab at the pub. Jack's interview at Rolls Royce is Monday, he's weirdly chill about it, says he's done his prep. Femi just got engaged to Sophie!! Proposed on the beach in Cornwall last weekend, she cried, he cried. Zainab's started a pottery course on Wednesday nights and is obsessed, already made me a wonky mug. Must get Femi and Sophie a card.
Need to post the birthday parcel to Hana by Wednesday. Also pick up the dry cleaning and book the car in.
Kerry dropped by. Her redundancy meeting is next Thursday, HR want to 'discuss options'. She's sick with worry. Her mum's coming down the day before to help with the kids. Must call her that evening.
Manon is back from France. The funeral went as well as these things can, her brother Antoine did the eulogy. She's back at work Monday which seems too soon. Take her for lunch next week.
Sara got it!! Edinburgh, starting in January. She's moving up with her partner after Christmas. Already planning a leaving party for mid December. Get her something nice for the new flat.

Catch up w Kai. Says he's doing alright since the breakup, joined a climbing gym, goes Tues and Thurs. His boss is making him reapply for his own role in a restructure, interview Friday. He's pretty anxious. Wish him luck Thursday night.
Called off - Deepa's leaving drinks on Friday aren't happening, half the team have covid. Rescheduled for whenever. Deepa still starts the new job on the 1st.
Marisol's grandad passed away overnight. Sara rang to tell me. Marisol's going home to Bogotá on Tuesday and won't be back for a fortnight. Remind me to message Marisol before she flies.

Spoke to Aisha on the walk home. Her son starts nursery next week and she's back at work three days after, which she's dreading. Her husband's been job hunting since the summer, two interviews this week, one Tuesday and one Thursday. She's holding everything together and she's knackered. Her mum's offered to have the little one on Fridays. Aisha said she'd love a proper night out once things settle.

Rin heard back from the museum this morning. Didn't get the job, they went with an internal candidate, which she says she half expected. She's gutted though, she'd already pictured herself there. Says she'll reapply when the next round opens in spring. Kalani is taking her to the coast this weekend to cheer her up. Send Rin something small, she likes those fancy matcha tins from the place in Soho.
Jamal's got an interview next Wednesday at a design studio in Leeds! First one since the redundancy. Suzanne says he's practising answers on her every night. Ask Jamal how it went on Thursday.
Kwame's first week at the bank sounds rough. Long hours, his manager barely speaks to him. He said he's thinking of going back to his old place. Meet him for a drink next Friday.
Moira messaged. Biscuit's stitches come out Monday. She's also got her own knee op the week after, which she's dreading. Offer to walk Biscuit while she recovers.
Lindiwe passed her PhD interview, she's in! Adaeze threw a little party at theirs the next day. Lindiwe starts in October. She wants to frame the acceptance letter lol.
Chat with Amy at the station. She's settled in the new place, a flat share near the canal. Hasn't really talked to Miriam since. Amy's applying for teaching jobs, two applications in already.
Archie didn't get the uni job. They phoned the next morning. He's going to try the one at the college instead, deadline Friday. I said I'd read his cover letter tomorrow.
Femi and Sophie's engagement party is Saturday the 14th at her parents' place. Need to sort a present. Sophie mentioned they want one of those fancy coffee machines.
Zainab - Zee - says her grandmother is very ill. The family's gathering this weekend in Birmingham. Zee's going up Friday after work. Text her Saturday morning to see how she's doing.
Gym, then Tesco, then sort the boiler man for Thursday. Remember the bins tomorrow.
Wiremu's back. Wi said the unveiling was beautiful, the whole marae turned out. He brought back a pounamu for his daughter.

Jack got the Rolls Royce job! Starts in three weeks. His girlfriend Hana says he's pretending to be cool about it but he's buzzing. They're doing a celebration dinner on Saturday. Congratulate Jack properly.

Long recap with Kerry: redundancy confirmed, last day is the end of November. She gets a decent payout and wants to retrain as a counsellor. Her mum is staying a week afterwards to help out. Kerry's still a bit shaky but more hopeful than last time. Her daughter Kalani has her grade 5 piano exam the same week, which is a lot. Should take Kerry out for a proper lunch the week after she finishes.
Manon's mum is struggling since Manon's dad died. Manon's going to Lyon again in a fortnight to help clear the house. Antoine can't get time off. Manon said she'd ring me the day she gets back.
Deepa's first day is tomorrow! She's nervous about the commute. Text her good luck in the morning.
Kai rang after his restructure interview. Kept his job but on a lower grade. Not sure how he feels. His sister Lena says he's angry. Check in with Kai at the weekend.
Abebe's back from Addis. The wedding was three days long apparently. His cousin's moving to London next spring so he'll see more of her. He's knackered and jet lagged.

Dinner w Aisha and Anil. Anil's doing better, been back at work a month since his mum's funeral. He's taking his dad to Kerala at Easter to scatter her ashes. Aisha's husband got the job he interviewed for.
Sophie's been offered a promotion but it means relocating to Bristol. She has until next Friday to decide. Femi's not keen. She asked me to call her Sunday to talk it through.
Suzanne - Jamal's partner - told me her company is doing layoffs in the new year. She doesn't know yet if she's affected. Hasn't told Jamal everything. She's anxious. Coffee with her next Tuesday.

Lena got a callback for the head of marketing job, final round on the 22nd. She's prepping a presentation for it. Her dog Mochi ate one of her shoes the day before, chaos. Remind me to ask Lena how the final went.
Chris and his wife are expecting! Due in May. They told everyone at Tariq's after the funeral, which was a bit odd but lovely. Chris is already reading every baby book going.
Rin's reapplying to the museum in March. Meanwhile she's temping at a gallery. Kalani's half marathon is on the 9th, Rin and I are going to cheer. Make a sign the night before.

Femi rang. His dad's been made redundant after thirty years at the plant, they told him on Friday with no warning. Femi's worried he'll just sit at home and stew, he's never not worked. His mum's trying to get him to see it as early retirement. His dad loves fishing, so maybe a day trip to the lakes. Femi wants to plan something for the weekend after next and asked if I'd come.
Kwame quit the bank. Going back to his old job in a fortnight, they were thrilled. Feels a bit embarrassed. Tell him it's fine, honestly.
Marisol's back from Bogotá. Says the funeral was huge, the whole village came. She's taking things slowly. Sara is cooking for her Friday, I'm bringing pudding.
Moira's knee op is Wednesday. Her son Jack is taking her in that morning and staying the night. I'm walking Biscuit Thursday and Friday. Send her a get well card.
Zainab's grandmother passed on Sunday. Funeral was the next day as is custom. Zainab's staying with her mum for a week. Should drop a food parcel round to Zainab's mum's.
Talked to Adaeze. She's applying for jobs in Glasgow so they can move when Lindiwe starts the PhD. Interview at the NHS Board next Monday by video. She's a bit nervous about doing it on camera.

Antoine's been texting. He's split up with his long term boyfriend, around the time of the funeral apparently, so he was dealing with both at once. Manon didn't even know until last week. He's coming to London next month for a work thing and wants to meet up. Offer him the sofa.
Hana's 30th is on the 8th! Jack's planning a surprise dinner the Saturday before. She's been hinting about wanting a record player. Chip in with Jack for it.
Amy got a teaching job! Year 4 at a primary in Hackney, starts after Easter. She's thrilled. Miriam texted me to say she's glad for her, which is nice. Send Amy congrats.
Kalani's piano exam is the same Thursday as Kerry's last day. Kerry's mum is taking Kalani. Kerry's leaving drinks are that evening at the Swan. I'll go straight after work.
Jamal didn't get Leeds but they want him for freelance work. He's okay with it. Suzanne's still waiting to hear about her layoffs, they find out Monday. Text Suzanne Monday night.
Wedding's off - Sophie and Femi called it off on Saturday. Sophie's staying at her sister's. Femi's devastated. Don't mention the coffee machine. Ring Femi tomorrow.
Archie got the college job! Starts January. Said my cover letter edits helped which was sweet. He's having drinks at his on Friday night, everyone's invited. Bring something fizzy.
